title: convolvulus cantabrica subsp. mazicum
intro: Convolvulus cantabrica subsp. mazicum, commonly known as Cantabrica or Mazicum bindweed, is a plant species within the Convolvulaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with benefits including soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Convolvulus cantabrica subsp. mazicum are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce spasms, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
